summary.text: Natalie Mihalek is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 40 who took office on December 1, 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a former assistant district attorney.

paragraphs.text: Mihalek first won District 40 in the November 6, 2018 general election, defeating Sharon Guidi and succeeding John Maher.
She won re-election in 2020, 2022 and 2024, defeating Guidi, Chris Todd and Peter Kohnke in those years respectively.
In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, Mihalek listed the opioid epidemic, securing and funding schools, and cutting wasteful government spending as her top three priorities.
She wrote that her work as a former Assistant District Attorney shaped her focus on the opioid crisis.
Democrat Jon Lloyd is her opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
